This set is one tier above [[Carapace Armor]] and the [[Eitr-weave Set]], and should be considered a "medium armor," as it has a lower armor value than [[Flametal Armor]], but a higher armor value than the [[Embla Set]]. Wearing all three pieces provides the [[Ask's Endurance]] set bonus, reducing stamina usage from running, jumping, and attacking, and providing +10% [[Pierce]] damage. ==Armor pieces== This set of armor has three pieces which are crafted and upgraded at the [[Black Forge]]. Beyond their normal maximum quality, they can be upgraded further at the [[Forge of Potential]] with a [[Flametal Protection Idol]]. 1= ===Quality 1=== Black forge level: 3
